entries.title: Fullscreen & Auth Layout Update
items: Enabled immersive fullscreen across the app so Android system bars stay hidden during play.
Updated the login and create account backgrounds to fit the full landscape display instead of cropping.
Reduced and tightened authentication fields and buttons for a cleaner layout with less scrolling.
Narrowed and centered the authentication form area while keeping scrolling available as a fallback.
Included the latest Help & Support, About, Privacy Policy, Terms & Legal, and DABSKY splash improvements.
Replaced the unstable splash renderer with hardware-safe animated glow, haze, shimmer, and water movement.
Rebuilt authentication sizing for landscape and changed Create Account to a compact two-row field layout.
Made fullscreen apply from the app theme and automatically re-hide Android system bars.

entries.title: Hub Rebuild & Navigation
items: Rebuilt the hub around the new Astral Forge background artwork.
Added Daily Reward and Event buttons with in-hub Coming Soon popups.
Added the top-right Account & Settings dropdown.
Added Player Account, Settings, Update Log, Help & Support, About, and Sign Out actions.
Locked the Android experience to landscape orientation.

entries.title: Battle & Game Systems
items: Expanded the battle screen foundation and sprite pipeline.
Added character and monster animation asset support.
Added game settings, music, haptics, and performance preferences.
Added player stats and allocatable attribute points.
